answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 13 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 556 identities costs 556 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. A whisper of doubt is healthy, a dawn of proof is required, and a ferrous of patience is the price of a clean panel.
